sections.description:
THE (PUNJAB) ADVOCATES BENEVOLENT
THE (PUNJAB) ADVOCATES BENEVOLENT
FUND RULES, 1974
(Substitution of R. 2.2)
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
22nd November, 2017]
No. 22311 PB.B.C., dated 7.11.2017.---In exercise of the powers conferred on it by
section 56 of the Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973 (XXXV of
1973), the Punjab Bar Council has made the certain Amendments in The
(Punjab) Advocates Benevolent Fund Rules, 1974 to the following effects:
"In the (Punjab) Advocates Benevolent Fund
Rules, 194, in Rule 2.2, the following shall be substituted, namely:-
"2.2. Contribution towards Benevolent Fund
shall not be charged from the applicants for admission as advocates beyond the
age of 35 years. Henceforth, the B.F. Contribution shall be received according
to the following schedule:
A. COMPULSORY
FOR THE SCHEME OF RS. 300,000/-
i.
Uptil the age of 25
years;
Rs. 10,000/-
ii.
Above 25 and uptil 30
years of age
Rs. 15,000/-
iii.
Above 30 and uptil 35
years age
Rs. 20,000/-
B. OPTIONAL FOR
THE SCHEME OF RS. 600,000/-
i.
Uptil the age of 25 years
Rs. 20,000/-
ii.
Above the age of 25 and uptil 30 years
Rs. 30,000/-
iii.
Above the age of 30 and uptil 35 years of age
Rs. 40,000/-
Substituted by
Bar Council Meeting 07.12.2013.
